title: State-to-DOM Renderer
prompt:
Write `renderTasks(state)` that returns an HTML STRING (never touches the DOM directly): tasks ordered by done ascending then priority weight high=3, medium=2, low=1, each rendered as `
  • TITLE
    • ` — class "done" only when done is true. Plus `nextId(state)` returning the next numeric id as a string.

tests.name: renders sorted, done class only where earned
tests.hint: Copy + sort with a weight map; build strings with map/join.

tests.name: nextId is max + 1
